E0352

`#Meta` maturity needs a known maturity value.

What

`#Meta` maturity needs a known maturity value.

Why

Maturity metadata is a closed documentation scale.

Fix

Write `maturity: .Experimental`, `.Tested`, or `.Hardened`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0352: tests/ui/meta_bad_maturity.stderr.

 Why: maturity metadata is a closed documentation scale
